name: Natsuyasumi Dayo! Oyakodon ~Mama mo Issho ni Vacance Nikki~
original_name: 夏休みだよ！親子丼 ～ママも一緒にバカンス日記～
source:
College student Hiromu is returning home to parents for summer vacation. Meanwhile, he takes a part-time job in near the holiday villa, where he meets beautiful mother and daughter Misao and Misaki. 
Despite defiant attitude Misaki is very curious about sex. And Misao, who is sexually frustrated, will start be a very spirited.
Spending one week with these two Hiromu will experience a lot of sweet temptation every day.
translation:
大学生木下弘梦在暑假回父母家。与此同时，他在附近的度假别墅找到一份兼职，并在那里遇见美丽的母女美纱绪和美咲。
尽管态度倔强，美咲对性十分好奇。性欲得不到满足的美纱绪也变得格外热情。
与母女二人共度的一周里，弘梦每天都会经历许多甜蜜诱惑。
